summary: Completed API and browser testing for catalog, buyer/seller auth, registration, search/filtering, wishlist, comparison, assistant, property contact, seller listing entry, and mobile layout.

integration_issues.issue: API returns source=lumina-insights and uses deterministic local matching when GEMINI_API_KEY is unavailable; this does not satisfy the requested live Google Gemini integration.

action_items: Replace or explicitly gate the deterministic assistant fallback with the required Google Gemini API integration and add coverage for AI failure states.
critical_code_review_comments: server.js implements AI assistant and analysis as deterministic local heuristics; no Gemini request is made even though the product requirement calls for Google Gemini.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_reg_lumina@example.com seller registration account; no catalog records were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested UI/API flows passed against the public preview. Re-test assistant after Gemini integration; verify analysis endpoint and seller listing submission UI when expanded.
rca of the issue: The /api/ai/assistant handler only queries MongoDB and constructs a canned reply; it selects source based on GEMINI_API_KEY but never calls Gemini. This is an implementation gap rather than a proxy or frontend failure.
